input.summary: Insert a free-standing transition assistance and data delivery clause at the end of Article 14
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.3 only operates on termination under Section 14.2 (and not if a Program Transfer occurs), and its transition and data delivery periods are left open, so we have added a short Section 14.5 giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and delivery of our trial data within 30 days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback exit position; we are happy to discuss the 6-month/then-current-rates formulation instead.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Delivery. Upon expiration or any termination of this Agreement, SFJ shall (a) at PB's request, provide PB with reasonable transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, deliver to PB all data generated in connection with the Clinical Trials, including the Trial Data Package and the Research Results included therein.
